prompt.zh-TW: 海風衝浪店向銀行借了 {{money:vars.loan}} 來整修店面，約定三年後一次還清。這筆借款在資產負債表上要放在哪裡？
prompt.en: Seabreeze Surf borrows {{money:vars.loan}} from the bank to refurbish the shop, to be repaid in one sum three years from now. Where does this loan belong on the balance sheet?

text.zh-TW: 非流動負債的長期借款

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。一年內不用還的債務放非流動負債。
feedback.en: Nice work. A debt that does not fall due within a year goes under non-current liabilities.

text.zh-TW: 流動負債，因為這筆錢遲早要還
text.en: Current liabilities, because the money has to be repaid sooner or later

feedback.zh-TW: 它確實是一筆要還的負債，這點沒錯。不過流動與非流動分的是「多快要還」：三年後才到期，一年內不會用到店裡的現金，所以放非流動負債。
feedback.en: It is indeed a debt that has to be repaid, that much is right. But current versus non-current is about how soon: due in three years, it will not call on the shop’s cash within the year, so it sits under non-current liabilities.

text.zh-TW: 流動資產，因為借來的錢已經進了帳戶
text.en: Current assets, because the borrowed money is already in the bank account

feedback.zh-TW: 借來的錢確實讓現金變多，這點沒錯。不過現金是左邊的資產，而「欠銀行的錢」這件事要記在右邊的負債；一筆借款會同時動到兩邊。
feedback.en: The borrowed money does increase cash, that much is right. But cash is the asset on the left; the fact that the bank is owed is recorded as a liability on the right. A loan touches both sides at once.

explanation.zh-TW: 負債依到期時間分成兩組：一年內要付的放{{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}，一年後才到期的放{{term:tm_adqjyfqg}}。三年後還的借款屬於後者，所以是{{option:o_yevs}}。{{option:o_0hxk}}忽略了到期時間，{{option:o_atcq}}則把收到的現金和欠的債混在一起。
explanation.en: Liabilities are split by when they fall due: those payable within a year go under {{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}, those due later under {{term:tm_adqjyfqg}}. A loan repayable in three years belongs to the second group, so {{option:o_yevs}} is right. {{option:o_0hxk}} ignores the due date, and {{option:o_atcq}} mixes up the cash received with the debt owed.
